name: Open Door Medical Clinic
description: A clinic in the Njinebai quarter of Guneku. It closed for months during the crisis years and reopened to the public in late 2020 with the support of the Fon. In 2021 the launch of an eye unit at Open Door was announced.

recordedActivity.activity: Reopened to the public after months of closure, with the support of the Fon.
The launch of a fully operational eye unit was announced. Whether it is operating today has not been confirmed.

statusNote: The clinic is open. The eye unit is listed among our development projects as a past announcement.
sourceNote: Recorded 2026-09-02 from the community record of December 2020 and the existing village register entry.
